class.name: CabinSystem
class.description: Kept apart from vehicle commands ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_send_command]), which execute on the vehicle immediately. Holds a [CabinState] per cabin and a registry of cabin control handlers. A cabin is its [VehicleServer] handle ([RailVehicleServer] knows which of the vehicle's cabs it is), a vehicle its [VehicleServer] handle - never its scenery name, which two vehicles may share and one may lack. Cabin controls only report manipulations through [method act]; the handlers are registered by the [CabinLogic] attached to the vehicle (a plugin's) - for the cabin its driver sits in - and translate them into vehicle commands. [CabinSystem] itself has no cabin logic and forwards nothing by default.

method.name: act
method.description: Reports a manipulation of a cabin control: [param action] is one of [code]increase[/code], [code]decrease[/code], [code]hold[/code], [code]release[/code], [code]toggle[/code], [code]set[/code]. Returns the handler's result, or [code]null[/code] when no handler is registered for the control.

method.name: cabin_get_dashboard_light_enabled
method.description: Whether the dashboard light of the cabin is lit; a cab not shown works it out first.

method.name: cabin_get_instrument_light_enabled
method.description: Whether the instrument light of the cabin is lit; a cab not shown works it out first.

method.name: cabin_get_light_level
method.description: The level (0..1) the cab light shines at; a cab not shown works it out first.

method.name: cabin_get_timetable_light_enabled
method.description: Whether the timetable light of the cabin is lit; a cab not shown works it out first.

method.name: cabin_set_dashboard_light_enabled
method.description: Lights or puts out the dashboard light of the cabin.

method.name: cabin_set_instrument_light_enabled
method.description: Lights or puts out the instrument light of the cabin.

method.name: cabin_set_light_level
method.description: The cab light of a cabin at [param level] (0..1); the vehicle's drawing follows [signal cabin_light_level_changed].

method.name: cabin_set_timetable_light_enabled
method.description: Lights or puts out the timetable light of the cabin.

method.name: cabin_show
method.description: The interior of the cabin built under [param parent], which rides on its vehicle (the caller mounts it) - the cab keeps its own place in the vehicle's frame. It is built within [method Node.add_child], so it returns built. One interior a vehicle is shown: the one of another of its cabins is rebuilt for this one. [code]null[/code] for a vehicle without a cab.

method.name: component_create
method.description: A control the implementation registered as [param implementation] makes by [param name] - a name of [method component_list] - with its defaults; [code]null[/code] for no such implementation or control.

method.name: component_list
method.description: The controls the implementation registered as [param implementation] can make, each once; none for no such implementation.

method.name: get_actions
method.description: The manipulations a control can report ([method act]).

method.name: get_cabin_state
method.description: The state of the cabin, made on first use.

method.name: get_control
method.description: The current value of a control of the cabin.

method.name: get_controls
method.description: Control ids with a registered handler in the cabin, sorted.

method.name: get_state
method.description: A copy of the current values of the cabin's controls, by control id.

method.name: has_control
method.description: Whether the cabin has a handler for the control.

method.name: implementation_register
method.description: [param implementation] builds the cabs whose [member Cabin3D.implementation] is [param name]; a name registered again is built by the new one.

method.name: implementation_unregister
method.description: Forgets the implementation registered as [param name].

method.name: register_control
method.description: Registers the handler of a control of the cabin: [code]handler(state: CabinState, action: StringName, value: Variant) -> Variant[/code].

method.name: register_display_process
method.description: [code]callable(state: CabinState, delta: float)[/code] for what only the cab shows - its lights: run with the simulation while the interior of the cabin's vehicle is shown, and for a cab not shown when it is about to be ([method cabin_show]) or something reads it ([method cabin_get_light_level], ...). It must work its result out of the state as it is, not of the time passed.

method.name: register_process
method.description: [code]callable(state: CabinState, delta: float)[/code], called with every step of the simulation while registered. The list is replaced, never changed in place, so a step walks the one it started with even when a callable registers or unregisters on the way.

method.name: state_computed_value_register
method.description: The cab shows a value of the vehicle's state as it computes it, not as the vehicle has it: [code]callable() -> Variant[/code], asked by [method vehicle_state_value] for [param key] of this vehicle until [method state_computed_value_unregister].

method.name: state_computed_value_unregister
method.description: Ends [method state_computed_value_register] of [param key].

method.name: unregister_control
method.description: Unregisters the handler of the control, if it is still [param handler].

method.name: unregister_display_process
method.description: Ends [method register_display_process].

method.name: unregister_process
method.description: Ends [method register_process].

method.name: vehicle_attach_cab_logic
method.description: The cab logic of a vehicle; [code]null[/code] detaches it. One per vehicle, whoever drives it - the player's cab and the AI act on the same controls - registered for the cabin its driver sits in ([method RailVehicleServer.vehicle_get_driver_cabin]) while somebody drives it.

method.name: vehicle_component
method.description: One component of the vehicle, by kind - for an element that reads a value often enough to want the typed property rather than the dump.

method.name: vehicle_config
method.description: The vehicle's configuration ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_dump_config]).

method.name: vehicle_get_cab_logic
method.description: The cab logic attached to the vehicle, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: vehicle_get_cabin_scene
method.description: The cab interior of the vehicle ([method vehicle_set_cabin_scene]), or [code]null[/code].

method.name: vehicle_has_low_voltage
method.description: Whether the vehicle has its low voltage, without which every lamp of its cab is dark.

method.name: vehicle_hide_cabin
method.description: The cab interior freed; a camera put into it is to be taken out first.

method.name: vehicle_set_cabin_scene
method.description: The cab interior of a vehicle, a scene rooted in a [Cabin3D] - what [method cabin_show] builds. Only a view: the cab logic is the vehicle's ([method vehicle_attach_cab_logic]).

method.name: vehicle_state
method.description: The whole vehicle's state, by name. [VehicleServer] builds it once per step and keeps it until the step or a command moves it on, so the dozens of elements of a cab asking in one frame share one dump. An element that reads one value often enough to care takes its component instead ([method vehicle_component]).

method.name: vehicle_state_value
method.description: One named value of the vehicle's state. A value the cab computes ([method state_computed_value_register]) is answered by its callable.

signal.name: cabin_dashboard_light_changed
signal.description: The dashboard light of a cabin came on or went out ([method cabin_set_dashboard_light_enabled]).

signal.name: cabin_instrument_light_changed
signal.description: The instrument light of a cabin came on or went out ([method cabin_set_instrument_light_enabled]).

signal.name: cabin_light_level_changed
signal.description: The light of a cabin shines at another level ([method cabin_set_light_level]).

signal.name: cabin_timetable_light_changed
signal.description: The timetable light of a cabin came on or went out ([method cabin_set_timetable_light_enabled]).

signal.name: control_changed
signal.description: A control of a cabin has another value ([method CabinState.set_value]).

signal.name: vehicle_cabin_built
signal.description: The interior of a vehicle's cab was built and is shown now - in the tree and drawn ([method cabin_show], which hands the same [param cabin] to whoever shows it); once per interior, showing another cab of the vehicle rebuilds the same one. Never emitted for a cab scene merely set ([method vehicle_set_cabin_scene]).

signal.name: vehicle_cabin_scene_changed
signal.description: The vehicle has a cab scene to show now ([method vehicle_set_cabin_scene]) - one its builder hands over after the vehicle has its simulation, and may already be driven.

signal.name: vehicle_command_received
signal.description: A command reached the vehicle, from wherever - the console, a keybind, another cab. Relayed here so a cabin element can react without ever holding the vehicle itself - for the vehicles of the shown cabs' trainsets only.
